This includes driving product vision, collaborating with internal teams, and ensuring alignment with airline partners’ goals and success metrics.\n\n - Optimize Existing Solutions: Work with airlines to improve and grow existing fintech products, ensuring they meet evolving business needs and maximize ancillary revenue opportunities.\n\n - Product Implementations: Lead product implementations and delivery for diverse accounts, including project and stakeholder management, maintaining documentation, executing user acceptance testing and issue triaging.\n\n - Data-Driven Insights: Leverage analytical tools and data to monitor product performance, assess customer feedback, and make data-backed decisions to optimize product offerings.\n\n - Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with internal teams (engineering, design, marketing, and customer success) to deliver seamless product experiences.\n\n - Market Intelligence: Stay up-to-date with trends in the fintech and travel industries to anticipate market shifts and identify new opportunities for innovation.\n\nAn ideal candidate has\n\n - Strong interpersonal and communication skills to engage with stakeholders at all levels. Someone who can build trust with partners and internal teams through clarity, consistency, and professionalism.\n\n - Ability in vibe coding/ prototyping products/ features or workflows with AI tooling like LLM (Claude, Gemini, Chatgpt, etc)\n\n - Proven ability to manage and grow strategic partnerships.\n\n - Excellent analytical skills with experience in data-driven decision-making.\n\n - Creativity and strategic thinking to identify new opportunities in the fintech and travel spaces.\n\n - Strong project management and organizational skills.\n\n - Familiarity with airline operations, challenges, and revenue streams, or previous experience working within the airline industry is a strong plus.\n\n - Native Arabic speaker with fluency in English. The ability to communicate effectively with ME and NA partners and stakeholders is crucial.\n   \n   \n   Perks and benefits of working with us:\n   \n   - Well-funded and proven startup with large ambitions, competitive salary and upsides of pre-IPO equity packages.\n   \n   - Hopper covers 100% of employee premiums for EOR - offered supplemental insurance including coverage for Medical, as well as Dental.\n   \n   - Please ask us about our very generous parental leave, much above industry standards!.\n   \n   - Access to co-working space on demand through FlexDesk AND Work-from-home stipend.\n   \n   - Housing & Transportation Benefit.\n   \n   - Carrot Cash travel stipend.\n   \n   - Unlimited PTO.\n   \n   - Entrepreneurial culture where pushing limits and taking risks is everyday business.\n   \n   - Open communication with management and company leadership.\n   \n   - Small, dynamic teams = massive impact.\n   \n   \n   \n   \n   MORE ABOUT HOPPER\n\nAt Hopper, we are on a mission to become the leading travel platform globally – powering Hopper’s mobile app, website and our B2B business, HTS (Hopper Technology Solutions). By leveraging massive amounts of data and advanced machine learning algorithms, Hopper combines its world-class travel agency offering with proprietary fintech products to bring transparency, flexibility and savings to travelers globally. We have developed several unique fintech solutions that address everything from pricing volatility to trip disruptions – helping people travel better and save more on their trips.\n\n\n\nThe Hopper platform serves hundreds of millions of travelers globally and continues to capture market share around the world. he Hopper app has been downloaded over 120 million times and has become largely popular among younger travelers – with 70% of its users being Gen Z and millennials.\n\n\n\nWhile everyone knows us as the Gen Z and Millennial travel app, Hopper has evolved to become much more than that. In recent years, we’ve grown into a travel fintech provider, commerce platform, and global travel agency that powers some of the world’s largest brands.\n\n\n\nThrough HTS, our B2B division, the company supercharges its partners’ direct channels by integrating our fintech products on their sites or powering end-to-end travel portals. Today, our partners include leading travel brands like Capital One, Nubank, Air Canada, and many more.\n\n\n\nHere are just a few stats that demonstrate the company’s recent growth:\n\n\n\nBillions of dollars worth of travel and travel fintech are sold through Hopper and HTS’ channels every year.\n\n\n\nOur fintech products – including Cancel for Any Reason and Flight Disruption Assistance – have exceptionally strong CSAT because the terms are always clear, and customers receive instant, no-questions-asked resolutions.\n\n\n\nAlmost 30% of our app customers purchase at least one fintech product when making a booking; and consumers are 1.6x more likely to repurchase if they add fintech to their booking vs if they booked just travel.\n\n\n\nGiven the success of its fintech products, Hopper launched a B2B initiative, HTS (Hopper Technology Solutions), which represents more than 75% of the business.\n\n\n\nThrough HTS, any travel provider (airlines, hotels, banks, travel agencies, etc.) can integrate and seamlessly distribute Hopper’s fintech or travel inventory on their direct channels. As its first HTS partnership, the company partnered with Capital One to co-develop Capital One Travel, a new travel portal designed specifically for cardholders. Other HTS partners include Air Canada, Uber, CommBank, Nubank, Flair Airlines and many more.\n\n\n\nHopper has been named the #1 most innovative company in travel by Fast Company Hopper has been downloaded over 120 million times and continues to have millions of new installs each month. Hopper is now the #3 largest online travel agencies in North America and 70% of our app customers are Gen-Z and millennials travelers.\n\n\n\nHopper has raised over $750 million USD of private capital and is backed by some of the largest institutional investors and banks in the world. HTS is primed to continue its growth as the leading travel ecommerce provider in a $1 trillion online shopping category. The successful candidate will engage with Hopper as an independent service provider and will not be considered a legal employee under the Qatar Labour Law (Law No. 14 of 2004). As the State of Qatar generally requires expatriates to have local visa sponsorship, the contractor is responsible for ensuring they have the legal right to work as a freelancer/contractor (e.g., via a self-sponsored visa or a business entity) and must manage all applicable local tax and social security requirements. This engagement is governed by a commercial service agreement and does not provide eligibility for company-sponsored benefits, statutory end-of-service gratuities, or paid leave typical of a standard sponsored employment contract.</em></p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"></p><h2><strong>More about Hopper</strong></h2></li></ul></li></ul><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">At Hopper, we are on a mission to become the leading travel platform globally – powering Hopper’s mobile app, website and our B2B business, HTS (Hopper Technology Solutions). By leveraging massive amounts of data and advanced machine learning algorithms, Hopper combines its world-class travel agency offering with proprietary fintech products to bring transparency, flexibility and savings to travelers globally. We have developed several unique fintech solutions that address everything from pricing volatility to trip disruptions – helping people travel better and save more on their trips.</p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"></p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">The Hopper platform serves hundreds of millions of travelers globally and continues to capture market share around the world. he Hopper app has been downloaded over 120 million times and has become largely popular among younger travelers – with 70% of its users being Gen Z and millennials.</p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"></p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">While everyone knows us as the Gen Z and Millennial travel app, Hopper has evolved to become much more than that. In recent years, we’ve grown into a travel fintech provider, commerce platform, and global travel agency that powers some of the world’s largest brands.</p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"></p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Through HTS, our B2B division, the company supercharges its partners’ direct channels by integrating our fintech products on their sites or powering end-to-end travel portals. Today, our partners include leading travel brands like Capital One, Nubank, Air Canada, and many more.<br /></p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><strong><u>Here are just a few stats that demonstrate the company’s recent growth:</u></strong></p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"></p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Billions of dollars worth of travel and travel fintech are sold through Hopper and HTS’ channels every year.</p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"></p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Our fintech products – including Cancel for Any Reason and Flight Disruption Assistance – have exceptionally strong CSAT because the terms are always clear, and customers receive instant, no-questions-asked resolutions.</p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"></p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Almost 30% of our app customers purchase at least one fintech product when making a booking; and consumers are 1.6x more likely to repurchase if they add fintech to their booking vs if they booked just travel.</p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"></p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Given the success of its fintech products, Hopper launched a B2B initiative, HTS (Hopper Technology Solutions), which represents more than 75% of the business.</p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"></p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Through HTS, any travel provider (airlines, hotels, banks, travel agencies, etc.) can integrate and seamlessly distribute Hopper’s fintech or travel inventory on their direct channels. As its first HTS partnership, the company partnered with Capital One to co-develop Capital One Travel, a new travel portal designed specifically for cardholders. Other HTS partners include Air Canada, Uber, CommBank, Nubank, Flair Airlines and many more.</p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"></p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Hopper has been named the #1 most innovative company in travel by Fast Company Hopper has been downloaded over 120 million times and continues to have millions of new installs each month. In recent years, we’ve grown into a travel fintech provider, commerce platform, and global travel agency that powers some of the world’s largest brands.\n\n\n\nThrough HTS, our B2B division, the company supercharges its partners’ direct channels by integrating our fintech products on their sites or powering end-to-end travel portals. This is a high-ownership individual contributor role reporting directly to the Global Corporate Controller, sitting at the intersection of technical accounting, data infrastructure, and commercial partnership. You'll mature manual workflows into a fully automated solution in NetSuite while serving as the primary Finance contact across a broad range of partner arrangements.</p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><strong>What would your day-to-day look like</strong></p><ul style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Design and build the end-to-end automated invoicing and revenue accounting cycle in NetSuite, converting current manual processes into a scalable, repeatable solution</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Liaise with the data warehouse team to reconcile source data, identify gaps, and drive corrections that ensure accurate data flows into accounting workflows</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Own the full invoicing cycle across all partner arrangements — revenue share, commissions, and other structures — from setup through collection</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Interpret and account for complex deal structures including tiered revenue share, variable commissions, clawbacks, and multi-element arrangements</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Ensure accurate revenue recognition under ASC 606 and draft technical accounting memos to support it</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Maintain the AR subledger, reconcile to the GL, and own month-end close across all partner revenue streams</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Use advanced SQL to independently pull, validate, and reconcile large transaction datasets across systems</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Read and interpret commercial contracts to surface accounting implications; partner with BD and Legal on new deal structuring</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Serve as the primary Finance contact for external partners on dispute resolution, remittance inquiries, and contract interpretation</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Oversee collections including aging review, escalation, and resolution of overdue balances</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Establish internal controls and support external audits related to revenue and partner accounting</p></li></ul><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><strong>An ideal candidate has</strong></p><ul style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">CPA designation with 8+ years of progressive accounting experience, including revenue recognition and partner or customer billing</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Advanced SQL skills — able to independently pull and reconcile data without relying on a data team</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Deep knowledge of ASC 606 and demonstrated experience drafting technical accounting memos</p></li><li><p cross-functionally with data engineering or warehouse teams</p></li></ul><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><em>This position requires proficiency in both French and English. Vous ferez évoluer les processus manuels vers une solution entièrement automatisée dans NetSuite, tout en agissant comme principal(e) interlocuteur(trice) financier(ère) pour un large éventail d'ententes avec des partenaires.\n\nÀ quoi ressemblerait votre quotidien\n\n - Concevoir et mettre en place le cycle automatisé de facturation et de comptabilité des revenus dans NetSuite, en transformant les processus manuels actuels en une solution évolutive et reproductible\n\n - Collaborer avec l'équipe de l'entrepôt de données pour réconcilier les données sources, identifier les lacunes et apporter les corrections nécessaires afin d'assurer des flux de données précis dans les processus comptables\n\n - Prendre en charge le cycle complet de facturation pour toutes les ententes avec les partenaires — partage des revenus, commissions et autres structures — de la mise en place jusqu'au recouvrement\n\n - Interpréter et comptabiliser des structures d'ententes complexes, notamment les partages de revenus échelonnés, les commissions variables, les récupérations et les arrangements à éléments multiples\n\n - Assurer une reconnaissance des revenus précise conformément à l'ASC 606 et rédiger les mémos comptables techniques nécessaires\n\n - Maintenir le grand livre auxiliaire des comptes clients, effectuer les rapprochements avec le grand livre général et gérer la clôture de fin de mois pour tous les flux de revenus des partenaires\n\n - Utiliser SQL avancé pour extraire, valider et réconcilier de grands ensembles de données transactionnelles de manière autonome, sans dépendre d'une équipe de données\n\n - Lire et interpréter les contrats commerciaux pour en dégager les implications comptables; The underlying technical capabilities — connectivity orchestration, pricing and sort, content mapping, the extranet — are owned by dedicated capability teams. Your job is to work closely with those PMs to understand, package, and commercially expose those capabilities as coherent, enterprise-grade API products.\n\n\nWe expect this PM to move fast and build scrappily. You should be comfortable using AI tools and vibe coding to prototype workflows, mock APIs, and test partner experiences before handing off to engineering. Define what the HTS API Marketplace is: how capabilities are structured, packaged, and priced across a portfolio spanning HTS Connect, Search Polygons, Autocomplete, Ranking, Content & Property Mapping, Room Mapping, Deduplication/Auction, Pricing, Extranet, Taxes, and Custom Deals Engine.\n\n - Coordinate with capability PMs — who own the underlying technical systems — to understand each capability's roadmap, constraints, and customization surface, and translate that into externally-consumable API products.\n\n - Own the commercial model for the marketplace: platform vs. variable fee decisions, take rate structure per capability, enterprise packaging, and the custom deals framework for large partners with differentiated customer segments.\n\n - Build the developer and partner experience from scratch: API specifications, partner onboarding flows, documentation standards, sandbox environments, and integration tooling that minimizes time-to-first-value.\n\n - Use AI tools and rapid prototyping to test ideas quickly — mock API responses, prototype partner portals, simulate pricing and ranking configurations — before committing engineering resources.\n\n - Establish the go-to-market motion for the marketplace: work with Commercial to identify the right partners for each capability, sequence launches, and define what a successful commercial rollout looks like.\n\n - Own the marketplace revenue P&L: model and track GBV, take rate, and per-capability unit economics in partnership with Finance.\n   \n\nAn ideal candidate has:\n\n - 7+ years of Product Management experience, with at least one 0-to-1 product you built from concept to commercial launch.\n\n - AI-native working style: you use LLMs and vibe coding as first-line tools for prototyping, not as novelties. In recent years, we’ve grown into a travel fintech provider, commerce platform, and global travel agency that powers some of the world’s largest brands.\n\n\n\nThrough HTS, our B2B division, the company supercharges its partners’ direct channels by integrating our fintech products on their sites or powering end-to-end travel portals. Vous serez la personne qui définit le produit : comment les capacités sont regroupées et tarifées, comment les partenaires les découvrent et les intègrent, et comment la place de marché évolue en tant que plateforme d'affaires. Les capacités techniques sous-jacentes — orchestration de la connectivité, tarification et tri, cartographie de contenu, extranet — sont détenues par des équipes de capacités dédiées. Votre rôle est de travailler en étroite collaboration avec ces gestionnaires de produits (PM) pour comprendre, packager et exposer commercialement ces capacités sous forme de produits API cohérents et de calibre entreprise.</p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Nous attendons de ce PM qu'il agisse rapidement avec agilité (<em>scrappily</em>). Vous devez être à l'aise avec les outils d'IA et la <strong>programmation intuitive (vibe coding)</strong> pour prototyper des flux de travail, simuler des API et tester l'expérience des partenaires avant de passer le relais à l'ingénierie. Le candidat idéal privilégiera toujours un prototype avant un document d’exigences produit (PRD).</p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Vous collaborerez avec les équipes d'ingénierie, de science des données, commerciales, financières et d'approvisionnement — et vous coordonnerez étroitement avec d'autres PM à travers l'organisation — pour faire passer la place de marché du concept à une plateforme génératrice de revenus.</p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"></p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><strong>Ce poste est entièrement en télétravail.</strong><br /></p><h2>Responsabilités</h2><ul Connect, les polygones de recherche, l'autocomplétion, le classement, la cartographie de contenu et de propriétés, la cartographie de chambres, la déduplication/enchères, la tarification, l'extranet, les taxes et le moteur d'accords personnalisés.</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><strong>Coordonner avec les PM de capacités :</strong> comprendre la feuille de route, les contraintes et les commercial :</strong> prendre les décisions entre frais de plateforme et frais variables, définir la structure de commission (<em>take rate</em>) par capacité, le packaging entreprise et le cadre d'accords personnalisés pour les grands partenaires.</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><strong>Bâtir l'expérience développeur et partenaire à partir de zéro :</strong> spécifications d'API, style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><strong>Utiliser l'IA et le prototypage rapide :</strong> tester les idées rapidement (simulations de réponses API, prototypes de portails partenaires) avant d'engager des ressources d'ingénierie.</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><strong>Établir la stratégie de mise en marché (GTM) :</strong> identifier les bons partenaires, séquencer les lancements et définir les critères de succès commerciaux.</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><strong>Gérer les revenus et pertes (P&amp;L) de la place de marché :</strong> modéliser et suivre le volume d'affaires commercial).</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><strong>Expérience démontrée</strong> dans la création de produits B2B ou de places de marché orientées développeurs, incluant la conception de You should be comfortable using AI tools and vibe coding to prototype workflows, mock APIs, and test partner experiences before handing off to engineering. The best candidate will reach for a prototype before a PRD.\n\nYou will partner with Engineering, Data Science, Commercial, Finance, and Supply — and coordinate tightly with other PMs across the organization — to bring the marketplace from concept to a revenue-generating platform.\n\nThis is a fully remote role.\n\n\n\nWHAT WOULD YOUR DAY-TO-DAY LOOK LIKE:\n\n - Define what the HTS API Marketplace is: how capabilities are structured, packaged, and priced across a portfolio spanning HTS Connect, Search Polygons, Autocomplete, Ranking, Content & Property Mapping, Room Mapping, Deduplication/Auction, Pricing, Extranet, Taxes, and Custom Deals Engine.\n\n - Coordinate with capability PMs — who own the underlying technical systems — to understand each capability's roadmap, constraints, and customization surface, and translate that into externally-consumable API products.\n\n - Own the commercial model for the marketplace: platform vs. variable fee decisions, take rate structure per capability, enterprise packaging, and the custom deals framework for large partners with differentiated customer segments.\n\n - Build the developer and partner experience from scratch: API specifications, partner onboarding flows, documentation standards, sandbox environments, and integration tooling that minimizes time-to-first-value.\n\n - Use AI tools and rapid prototyping to test ideas quickly — mock API responses, prototype partner portals, simulate pricing and ranking configurations — before committing engineering resources.\n\n - Establish the go-to-market motion for the marketplace: work with Commercial to identify the right partners for each capability, sequence launches, and define what a successful commercial rollout looks like.\n\n - Own the marketplace revenue P&L: model and track GBV, take rate, and per-capability unit economics in partnership with Finance.\n\n - Set the sequencing and prioritization across all capabilities — from in-progress work (HTS Connect, Taxes) through scoping-stage products (Content & Property Mapping, Room Mapping, Deduplication/Auction, Pricing) to capabilities not yet started (Search Polygons, Autocomplete, Ranking, Extranet, Custom Deals Engine).\n   \n\n\nAN IDEAL CANDIDATE HAS:\n\n - 7+ years of Product Management experience, with at least one 0-to-1 product you built from concept to commercial launch.\n\n - Demonstrated experience building developer-facing or B2B marketplace products, including ownership of API product design, developer experience, and commercial packaging for enterprise customers.\n\n - AI-native working style: you use LLMs and vibe coding as first-line tools for prototyping, not as novelties. You have built working demos, mockups, or proof-of-concepts using AI before handing work to engineering.\n\n - Strong understanding of marketplace economics: take rates, supply-side incentives, demand-side optimization, and the design of platform vs. variable commercial models.\n\n - Ability to coordinate effectively across multiple product teams — you can synthesize roadmaps, surface dependencies, and drive cross-team alignment without owning the underlying engineering.\n\n - Experience working with external enterprise partners: translating commercial needs into product requirements and managing partner expectations through multi-phase rollouts.\n\n - Strong fluency with SQL and large-scale transactional or operational datasets.\n\n - Exceptional written and verbal communication, including the ability to write crisp API and product documentation.\n\nBonus:\n\n - Experience in travel commerce (lodging, cars, flights) or adjacent industries such as fintech, ads, or marketplace infrastructure.\n\n - Background in connectivity, distribution, or supplier technology (GDS, channel managers, OTA APIs).\n\n - Prior experience in Engineering, Data Science, or a technical role.\n\n - Familiarity with auction or deduplication mechanics, dynamic pricing systems, or recommendation and ranking models.\n   \n\nThis position requires proficiency in both French and English. The successful candidate will be required to communicate and collaborate on a regular basis with colleagues, managers, clients, suppliers, and business partners located outside Quebec, and to review, prepare, and use documentation, systems, and communications in both French and English. Knowledge of English is therefore necessary for the performance of the duties associated with the position and to meet operational and client requirements in an international business environment.\n\n\n\n\nPERKS & BENEFITS OF WORKING WITH US:\n\n - Well-funded and proven startup with large ambitions, competitive salary and upsides of pre-IPO equity packages.\n\n - Hopper covers 100% of the premiums for group insurance plan.\n\n - Hopper offers life, short term and long term disability coverage.\n\n - HSA that covers eligible medical and dental expenses.\n\n - All employees and dependents have access to Dialogue’s telemedicine services, anytime, anywhere.\n\n - All employees have access to an RRSP plan with automatic pre-tax withdrawals per pay.\n\n - Please ask us about our very generous parental leave, much above industry standards!.\n\n - Unlimited PTO.\n\n - Carrot Cash travel stipend.\n\n - Access to co-working space on demand through FlexDesk AND Work-from-home stipend.\n\n - Entrepreneurial culture where pushing limits and taking risks is everyday business.\n\n - Open communication with management and company leadership.\n\n - Small, dynamic teams = massive impact.\n\n\n\nMore about Hopper\n\nAt Hopper, we are on a mission to become the leading travel platform globally – powering Hopper’s mobile app, website and our B2B business, HTS (Hopper Technology Solutions). By leveraging massive amounts of data and advanced machine learning algorithms, Hopper combines its world-class travel agency offering with proprietary fintech products to bring transparency, flexibility and savings to travelers globally. We have developed several unique fintech solutions that address everything from pricing volatility to trip disruptions – helping people travel better and save more on their trips.\n\n\n\nThe Hopper platform serves hundreds of millions of travelers globally and continues to capture market share around the world. he Hopper app has been downloaded over 120 million times and has become largely popular among younger travelers – with 70% of its users being Gen Z and millennials.\n\n\n\nWhile everyone knows us as the Gen Z and Millennial travel app, Hopper has evolved to become much more than that. In recent years, we’ve grown into a travel fintech provider, commerce platform, and global travel agency that powers some of the world’s largest brands.\n\n\n\nThrough HTS, our B2B division, the company supercharges its partners’ direct channels by integrating our fintech products on their sites or powering end-to-end travel portals. Today, our partners include leading travel brands like Capital One, Nubank, Air Canada, and many more.\n\nHere are just a few stats that demonstrate the company’s recent growth:\n\n\n\nBillions of dollars worth of travel and travel fintech are sold through Hopper and HTS’ channels every year.\n\n\n\nOur fintech products – including Cancel for Any Reason and Flight Disruption Assistance – have exceptionally strong CSAT because the terms are always clear, and customers receive instant, no-questions-asked resolutions.\n\n\n\nAlmost 30% of our app customers purchase at least one fintech product when making a booking; and consumers are 1.6x more likely to repurchase if they add fintech to their booking vs if they booked just travel.\n\n\n\nGiven the success of its fintech products, Hopper launched a B2B initiative, HTS (Hopper Technology Solutions), which represents more than 75% of the business.\n\n\n\nThrough HTS, any travel provider (airlines, hotels, banks, travel agencies, etc.) can integrate and seamlessly distribute Hopper’s fintech or travel inventory on their direct channels. As its first HTS partnership, the company partnered with Capital One to co-develop Capital One Travel, a new travel portal designed specifically for cardholders. Other HTS partners include Air Canada, Uber, CommBank, Nubank, Flair Airlines and many more.\n\n\n\nHopper has been named the #1 most innovative company in travel by Fast Company Hopper has been downloaded over 120 million times and continues to have millions of new installs each month. Hopper is now the #3 largest online travel agencies in North America and 70% of our app customers are Gen-Z and millennials travelers.\n\n\n\nHopper has raised over $750 million USD of private capital and is backed by some of the largest institutional investors and banks in the world. HTS is primed to continue its growth as the leading travel ecommerce provider in a $1 trillion online shopping category. Engagement is contingent upon providing proof of valid business registration and appropriate professional indemnity insurance.</em></p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><br /><strong>More about Hopper</strong></p></li></ul><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">At Hopper, we are on a mission to become the leading travel platform globally – powering Hopper’s mobile app, website and our B2B business, HTS (Hopper Technology Solutions). By leveraging massive amounts of data and advanced machine learning algorithms, Hopper combines its world-class travel agency offering with proprietary fintech products to bring transparency, flexibility and savings to travelers globally. We have developed several unique fintech solutions that address everything from pricing volatility to trip disruptions – helping people travel better and save more on their trips.</p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">The Hopper platform serves hundreds of millions of travelers globally and continues to capture market share around the world. he Hopper app has been downloaded over 120 million times and has become largely popular among younger travelers – with 70% of its users being Gen Z and millennials.</p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">While everyone knows us as the Gen Z and Millennial travel app, Hopper has evolved to become much more than that. In recent years, we’ve grown into a travel fintech provider, commerce platform, and global travel agency that powers some of the world’s largest brands.</p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Through HTS, our B2B division, the company supercharges its partners’ direct channels by integrating our fintech products on their sites or powering end-to-end travel portals. Today, our partners include leading travel brands like Capital One, Nubank, Air Canada, and many more.</p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Here are just a few stats that demonstrate the company’s recent growth:</p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Billions of dollars worth of travel and travel fintech are sold through Hopper and HTS’ channels every year.</p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Our fintech products – including Cancel for Any Reason and Flight Disruption Assistance – have exceptionally strong CSAT because the terms are always clear, and customers receive instant, no-questions-asked resolutions.</p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Almost 30% of our app customers purchase at least one fintech product when making a booking; and consumers are 1.6x more likely to repurchase if they add fintech to their booking vs if they booked just travel.</p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Given the success of its fintech products, Hopper launched a B2B initiative, HTS (Hopper Technology Solutions), which represents more than 75% of the business.</p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Through HTS, any travel provider (airlines, hotels, banks, travel agencies, etc.) can integrate and seamlessly distribute Hopper’s fintech or travel inventory on their direct channels. As its first HTS partnership, the company partnered with Capital One to co-develop Capital One Travel, a new travel portal designed specifically for cardholders. You will partner deeply with Data Science and Engineering to productionize predictive models, define evaluation frameworks, manage model lifecycles, and ensure intelligence systems are measurable, adaptive, and trusted.\n\nThe work you do will directly shape partner economics, supplier transparency, and HTS’s global commerce platform.\n\nWhat would your day-to-day look like:\n\n - Own the end-to-end strategy and roadmap for pricing intelligence, supplier performance intelligence, and financial reconciliation across all travel verticals.\n   Architect and evolve reference pricing systems leveraging predictive modeling, elasticity signals, competitive benchmarking, and real-time anomaly detection.\n\n - Build the supplier intelligence layer, transforming transactional data into automated performance signals, demand insights, and pricing diagnostics.\n\n - Establish and govern the canonical source of truth for revenue, margin, take rate, transactions, and cancellations across systems and partners.\n\n - Design model evaluation, monitoring, and feedback frameworks, including drift detection and continuous improvement mechanisms.\n\n - Drive cross-functional execution across Engineering, Data Science, Finance, Commercial, and Supply to deliver production-grade, model-integrated infrastructure.\n   \n\nAn ideal candidate has:\n\n - 5+ years of Product Management experience, including ownership of AI-native products and model-driven systems in production. Strong fluency working independently with SQL and large-scale transactional datasets.\n\n - Demonstrated experience operating as an AI-native PM, with hands-on ownership of model lifecycle management including problem framing, signal design, evaluation metrics (e.g., precision/recall tradeoffs, forecasting accuracy), monitoring frameworks, drift detection, and retraining strategies.\n\n - Experience shipping predictive systems, anomaly detection platforms, automated decisioning infrastructure, or model-driven pricing systems at scale.\n\n - Experience owning pricing systems, financial reporting platforms or marketplace intelligence tools.\n\n - Deep understanding of marketplace economics, revenue mechanics, and pricing strategy.\n\n - Track record of delivering complex, cross-functional systems with measurable business impact.\n\n - Exceptional communicator able to operate effectively across technical and commercial stakeholders.\n\nBonus:\n\n - financiers.</p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"></p><h2>À quoi ressemblera votre quotidien</h2><ul style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Prendre en charge le modèle opérationnel de paie mondiale de bout en bout pour les employés, les pigistes, les EOR, les PEO et les fournisseurs de paie locaux.</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Diriger et perfectionner une équipe de 2 à 3 subordonnés directs tout en maintenant une rigueur d'exécution et des normes opérationnelles élevées.</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Piloter l'administration opérationnelle de l'actionnariat des employés dans Shareworks, incluant le traitement des octrois, la mise à jour des données et la réconciliation interservices.</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Identifier et implanter des flux d'automatisation afin de minimiser les transferts manuels de données, les exceptions récurrentes et les frictions de données.</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Collaborer avec les équipes des technologies RH, des TI et des finances pour mener à bien la consolidation des plateformes de paie et maximiser la fiabilité des systèmes.</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Renforcer les protocoles de conformité, les contrôles de paie et la conservation de la documentation afin de protéger l'entreprise contre l'exposition financière et d'assurer la préparation aux audits.</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Établir des calendriers de traitement clairs, des indicateurs de responsabilité et des tableaux de bord de données pour mesurer l'exactitude de la fonction et les gains de capacité.</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Intervenir directement dans les dossiers complexes de fiscalité, d'équité et de paie propres à chaque marché afin de guider une résolution interfonctionnelle rapide.</p></li></ul><h2>Le candidat idéal possède</h2><ul style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><li><p Impact maximal : De petites équipes dynamiques pour un impact concret et direct.\n\n\nEN SAVOIR PLUS SUR HOPPER\n\nChez Hopper, nous avons pour mission de devenir la plateforme de voyage de référence à l'échelle mondiale – en propulsant l'application mobile Hopper, notre site Web ainsi que notre division B2B, HTS (Hopper Technology Solutions). En tirant parti de volumes massifs de données et d'algorithmes avancés d'apprentissage automatique, Hopper combine son offre d'agence de voyage de classe mondiale à des produits fintech exclusifs afin d'apporter transparence, flexibilité et économies aux voyageurs du monde entier. Nous avons développé plusieurs solutions fintech uniques qui répondent à tous les enjeux, de la volatilité des prix aux perturbations de voyage, aidant ainsi les gens à mieux voyager et à économiser davantage.\n\nLa plateforme Hopper sert des centaines de millions de voyageurs et continue de gagner des parts de marché partout dans le monde. L'application Hopper a été téléchargée plus de 120 millions de fois et est devenue particulièrement populaire auprès des jeunes voyageurs – 70 % de ses utilisateurs appartenant à la génération Z et aux millénariaux.\n\nBien que nous soyons reconnus comme l'application de voyage par excellence de la génération Z et des millénariaux, Hopper a grandement évolué. Au cours des dernières années, nous sommes devenus un fournisseur de fintech de voyage, une plateforme de commerce électronique et une agence de voyage mondiale qui propulse certaines des plus grandes marques au monde.\n\nGrâce à HTS, notre division B2B, l'entreprise dynamise les canaux directs de ses partenaires en intégrant nos produits fintech à leurs sites ou en propulsant leurs portails de voyage de bout en bout. Aujourd'hui, nos partenaires comptent des marques de voyage de premier plan telles que Capital One, Nubank, Air Canada et bien d'autres.\n\nVoici quelques statistiques qui témoignent de notre croissance récente :\n\n - Des milliards de dollars de voyages et de produits fintech de voyage sont vendus chaque année par l'entremise des canaux de Hopper et de HTS.\n\n - Nos produits fintech – incluant Annulation pour n'importe quel motif et Aide en cas de perturbation de vol – affichent des scores de satisfaction client (CSAT) exceptionnellement élevés, car les conditions sont toujours claires et les clients bénéficient de résolutions instantanées, sans poser de questions.\n\n - Près de 30 % des clients de notre application achètent au moins un produit fintech lors de leur réservation; et les consommateurs sont 1,6 fois plus susceptibles de réserver à nouveau s'ils ajoutent une option fintech, comparativement à un achat de voyage seul.\n\n - Fort du succès de ses produits fintech, Hopper a lancé l'initiative B2B HTS (Hopper Technology Solutions), qui représente aujourd'hui plus de 75 % des activités de l'entreprise.\n\n - Grâce à HTS, tout fournisseur de voyage (compagnies aériennes, hôtels, banques, agences de voyage, etc.) peut intégrer et distribuer de façon transparente la fintech ou l'inventaire de voyage de Hopper sur ses propres canaux directs. Dans le cadre de son premier partenariat HTS, l'entreprise s'est associée à Capital One pour co-développer Capital One Travel, un nouveau portail de voyage conçu spécifiquement pour ses titulaires de cartes. Parmi les autres partenaires de HTS figurent Air Canada, Uber, CommBank, Nubank, Flair Airlines et plusieurs autres.\n\n - Hopper a été nommée l'entreprise numéro 1 la plus innovante du secteur du voyage par Fast Company. L'application Hopper a dépassé les 120 millions de téléchargements et continue d'enregistrer des millions de nouvelles installations chaque mois. Hopper se classe désormais au 3e rang des plus grandes agences de voyages en ligne en Amérique du Nord.\n\n - Hopper a mobilisé plus de 750 millions de dollars USD en capitaux privés et est soutenue par certains des plus grands investisseurs institutionnels et banques au monde. HTS est idéalement positionnée pour poursuivre sa croissance en tant que leader du commerce électronique de voyage, au sein d'une catégorie d'achat en ligne qui représente 1 000 milliards de dollars. L'application et le site Web de Hopper resteront également les choix privilégiés de la génération Z et des millénariaux pour leurs voyages.\n   \n   \n\nCe poste fait appel à des systèmes de décision automatisée pour évaluer l'aptitude des candidats. Pour exercer ces droits, veuillez communiquer avec privacy@hopper.com.\n\nPrêt à décoller avec nous?\n\n\n*******************************\n\n\n\nABOUT THE ROLE\n\nAs the Senior Manager of Global Payroll Systems & Equity Operations at HTS, you will serve as a player-coach reporting to the Head of People Operations & Workforce Technology to modernize and scale our workforce compensation infrastructure. Sitting on the leadership team, your mandate is to transition the function away from manual, multi-vendor handoffs into an automated, highly scalable operating model that maximizes systemic efficiency without proportional headcount growth. This high-visibility role uniquely blends global cross-functional system design with hands-on execution to directly mitigate operational and financial risk..\n\n\n\n\nWHAT WOULD YOUR DAY-TO-DAY LOOK LIKE\n\n - Own the end-to-end global payroll operating model across employees, contractors, EORs, PEOs, and local providers.\n\n - Manage and develop a team of 2–3 direct reports while maintaining execution discipline and high operational standards.\n\n - Lead the operational administration of employee equity in Shareworks, covering grant processing, data updates, and multi-department reconciliation.\n\n - Identify and implement automation workflows to minimize manual data transfers, recurring exceptions, and data friction.\n\n - Partner with HR Technology, IT, and Finance to drive payroll platform consolidations and maximize system reliability.\n\n - Strengthen compliance protocols, payroll controls, and documentation to protect the business from financial exposure and ensure audit readiness.\n\n - Establish clear processing calendars, accountability metrics, and data scorecards to measure function accuracy and capacity gains.\n\n - Step into complex tax, equity, and market-specific payroll challenges to drive swift cross-functional resolution.\n\n\nAN IDEAL CANDIDATE HAS\n\n - Global Payroll Leadership: Proven experience managing multi-country payroll operations, specifically navigating EOR, PEO, and local provider frameworks.\n\n - Equity Administration Expertise: Direct familiarity handling equity platforms like Shareworks, including managing grant lifecycles and complex equity tax coordination.\n\n - Systems & Automation Focus: A strong track record of designing HRIS integrations, optimizing workflows, and intentionally removing manual touchpoints from financial operations.\n\n - Controls & Compliance Rigor: Deep knowledge of payroll controls, financial audit readiness, and tax implications within a high-growth technology or fintech corporate structure.\n\n - Player-Coach Capability: The demonstrated capability to manage and upskill a remote operational team while simultaneously acting as a hands-on technical expert.\n\n - Commercial & Analytical Mindset: The ability to convert complex operational patterns into clear, data-driven decisions that improve company-wide scaling efficiency\n\n\nBENEFITS \n\n - Well-funded and proven startup with large ambitions, competitive salary and upsides of pre-IPO equity packages.\n\n - Hopper covers 100% of the premiums for group insurance plan.\n\n - Hopper offers life, short term and long term disability coverage.\n\n - HSA that covers eligible medical and dental expenses.\n\n - All employees and dependents have access to Dialogue’s telemedicine services, anytime, anywhere.\n\n - All employees have access to an RRSP plan with automatic pre-tax withdrawals per pay.\n\n - Please ask us about our very generous parental leave, much above industry standards!.\n\n - Unlimited PTO.\n\n - Carrot Cash travel stipend.\n\n - Access to co-working space on demand through FlexDesk AND Work-from-home stipend.\n\n - Entrepreneurial culture where pushing limits and taking risks is everyday business.\n\n - Open communication with management and company leadership.\n\n - Small, dynamic teams = massive impact.\n\n\nMore about Hopper\n\nAt Hopper, we are on a mission to become the leading travel platform globally – powering Hopper’s mobile app, website and our B2B business, HTS (Hopper Technology Solutions). We have developed several unique fintech solutions that address everything from pricing volatility to trip disruptions – helping people travel better and save more on their trips.\n\n \n\nThe Hopper platform serves hundreds of millions of travelers globally and continues to capture market share around the world. he Hopper app has been downloaded over 120 million times and has become largely popular among younger travelers – with 70% of its users being Gen Z and millennials.\n\n \n\nWhile everyone knows us as the Gen Z and Millennial travel app, Hopper has evolved to become much more than that. In recent years, we’ve grown into a travel fintech provider, commerce platform, and global travel agency that powers some of the world’s largest brands.\n\n \n\nThrough HTS, our B2B division, the company supercharges its partners’ direct channels by integrating our fintech products on their sites or powering end-to-end travel portals. Today, our partners include leading travel brands like Capital One, Nubank, Air Canada, and many more.\n\nHere are just a few stats that demonstrate the company’s recent growth:\n\n \n\nBillions of dollars worth of travel and travel fintech are sold through Hopper and HTS’ channels every year.\n\n \n\nOur fintech products – including Cancel for Any Reason and Flight Disruption Assistance – have exceptionally strong CSAT because the terms are always clear, and customers receive instant, no-questions-asked resolutions.\n\n \n\nAlmost 30% of our app customers purchase at least one fintech product when making a booking; and consumers are 1.6x more likely to repurchase if they add fintech to their booking vs if they booked just travel.\n\n \n\nGiven the success of its fintech products, Hopper launched a B2B initiative, HTS (Hopper Technology Solutions), which represents more than 75% of the business.\n\n \n\nThrough HTS, any travel provider (airlines, hotels, banks, travel agencies, etc.) can integrate and seamlessly distribute Hopper’s fintech or travel inventory on their direct channels. In recent years, we’ve grown into a travel fintech provider, commerce platform, and global travel agency that powers some of the world’s largest brands.\n\n \n\nThrough HTS, our B2B division, the company supercharges its partners’ direct channels by integrating our fintech products on their sites or powering end-to-end travel portals. As its first HTS partnership, the company partnered with Capital One to co-develop Capital One Travel, a new travel portal designed specifically for cardholders. Other HTS partners include Air Canada, Uber, CommBank, Nubank, Flair Airlines and many more.\n\n \n\nHopper has been named the #1 most innovative company in travel by Fast Company Hopper has been downloaded over 120 million times and continues to have millions of new installs each month. Today, our partners include leading travel brands like Capital One, Nubank, Air Canada, and many more.</p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><strong><u>Here are just a few stats that demonstrate the company’s recent growth:</u></strong></p><div style=\"min-height:1.2em;margin-top:0;margin-bottom:0\"> </div><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Billions of dollars worth of travel and travel fintech are sold through Hopper and HTS’ channels every year.</p><div style=\"min-height:1.2em;margin-top:0;margin-bottom:0\"> </div><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Our fintech products – including Cancel for Any Reason and Flight Disruption Assistance – have exceptionally strong CSAT because the terms are always clear, and customers receive instant, no-questions-asked resolutions.</p><div style=\"min-height:1.2em;margin-top:0;margin-bottom:0\"> </div><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Almost 30% of our app customers purchase at least one fintech product when making a booking; and consumers are 1.6x more likely to repurchase if they add fintech to their booking vs if they booked just travel.</p><div style=\"min-height:1.2em;margin-top:0;margin-bottom:0\"> </div><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Given the success of its fintech products, Hopper launched a B2B initiative, HTS (Hopper Technology Solutions), which represents more than 75% of the business.</p><div style=\"min-height:1.2em;margin-top:0;margin-bottom:0\"> </div><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Through HTS, any travel provider (airlines, hotels, banks, travel agencies, etc.) can integrate and seamlessly distribute Hopper’s fintech or travel inventory on their direct channels. Lead the operational administration of employee equity in Shareworks, covering grant processing, data updates, and multi-department reconciliation.\n\n - Identify and implement automation workflows to minimize manual data transfers, recurring exceptions, and data friction.\n\n - Partner with HR Technology, IT, and Finance to drive payroll platform consolidations and maximize system reliability.\n\n - Strengthen compliance protocols, payroll controls, and documentation to protect the business from financial exposure and ensure audit readiness.\n\n - Establish clear processing calendars, accountability metrics, and data scorecards to measure function accuracy and capacity gains.\n\n - Step into complex tax, equity, and market-specific payroll challenges to drive swift cross-functional resolution.\n\n\nAN IDEAL CANDIDATE HAS\n\n - Systems & Automation Focus: A strong track record of designing HRIS integrations, optimizing workflows, and intentionally removing manual touchpoints from financial operations.\n\n - Controls & Compliance Rigor: Deep knowledge of payroll controls, financial audit readiness, and tax implications within a high-growth technology or fintech corporate structure.\n\n - Player-Coach Capability: The demonstrated capability to manage and upskill a remote operational team while simultaneously acting as a hands-on technical expert.\n\n - Commercial & Analytical Mindset: The ability to convert complex operational patterns into clear, data-driven decisions that improve company-wide scaling efficiency\n\n\nBENEFITS \n\n - We have developed several unique fintech solutions that address everything from pricing volatility to trip disruptions – helping people travel better and save more on their trips.</p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">The Hopper platform serves hundreds of millions of travelers globally and continues to capture market share around the world. he Hopper app has been downloaded over 120 million times and has become largely popular among younger travelers – with 70% of its users being Gen Z and millennials.</p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">While everyone knows us as the Gen Z and Millennial travel app, Hopper has evolved to become much more than that. In recent years, we’ve grown into a travel fintech provider, commerce platform, and global travel agency that powers some of the world’s largest brands.</p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Through HTS, our B2B division, the company supercharges its partners’ direct channels by integrating our fintech products on their sites or powering end-to-end travel portals. Today, our partners include leading travel brands like Capital One, Nubank, Air Canada, and many more.</p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Here are just a few stats that demonstrate the company’s recent growth:</p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Billions of dollars worth of travel and travel fintech are sold through Hopper and HTS’ channels every year.</p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Our fintech products – including Cancel for Any Reason and Flight Disruption Assistance – have exceptionally strong CSAT because the terms are always clear, and customers receive instant, no-questions-asked resolutions.</p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Almost 30% of our app customers purchase at least one fintech product when making a booking; and consumers are 1.6x more likely to repurchase if they add fintech to their booking vs if they booked just travel.</p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Given the success of its fintech products, Hopper launched a B2B initiative, HTS (Hopper Technology Solutions), which represents more than 75% of the business.</p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Through HTS, any travel provider (airlines, hotels, banks, travel agencies, etc.) can integrate and seamlessly distribute Hopper’s fintech or travel inventory on their direct channels. As its first HTS partnership, the company partnered with Capital One to co-develop Capital One Travel, a new travel portal designed specifically for cardholders. Other HTS partners include Air Canada, Uber, CommBank, Nubank, Flair Airlines and many more.</p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Hopper has been named the #1 most innovative company in travel by Fast Company Hopper has been downloaded over 120 million times and continues to have millions of new installs each month. Vous concevrez et mettrez à l'échelle une infrastructure pilotée par des modèles qui interprète en continu les données transactionnelles, génère des prix de référence, détecte les changements de performance, réconcilie les flux financiers et assure l'intégrité des revenus en temps réel.\n\nIl s'agit d'un rôle fondamental à l'intersection de l'économie de marché (marketplace), de l'apprentissage automatique (machine learning) et des systèmes financiers. Vous collaborerez étroitement avec les équipes de science des données et d'ingénierie pour mettre en production des modèles prédictifs, définir des cadres d'évaluation et garantir que nos systèmes d'intelligence sont mesurables, adaptatifs et fiables.\n\n\n\nCE À QUOI RESSEMBLERA TON TRAVAIL AU JOUR-LE-JOUR\n\n - Stratégie et feuille de route : Piloter la stratégie de bout en bout pour l'intelligence des prix, la performance des fournisseurs et la réconciliation financière pour tous les segments de voyage.\n\n - Architecture de prix de référence : Concevoir des systèmes de tarification utilisant la modélisation prédictive, les signaux d'élasticité et la détection d'anomalies en temps réel.\n\n - Intelligence fournisseur : Transformer les données transactionnelles en signaux de performance automatisés et en diagnostics de prix.\n\n - Gouvernance des données financières : Établir et gérer la source de vérité unique pour les revenus, les marges, les taux de commission (take rate), les transactions et les annulations.\n\n - Cycle de vie des modèles : Concevoir des cadres d'évaluation, de surveillance et de rétroaction des modèles, incluant la détection de dérive (drift detection).\n\n - Exécution interfonctionnelle : Collaborer avec l'ingénierie, la science des données, la finance et le commercial pour livrer une infrastructure de qualité production intégrée aux modèles.\n\n\nUN(E) CANDIDAT(E) IDÉAL(E):\n\n - 5 ans et plus d'expérience en gestion de produit, incluant la responsabilité de produits natifs de l'IA et de systèmes pilotés par des modèles en production.\n\n - Expérience pratique (« hands-on ») : Capacité à rédiger des prompts, concevoir des tests d'évaluation ou prototyper avec des LLM/modèles de fondation dans votre flux de travail (pas seulement superviser les autres).\n\n - Gestion du cycle de vie de l'IA : Maîtrise de la définition de problèmes, conception de signaux, mesures d'évaluation (ex. compromis précision/rappel), cadres de surveillance et stratégies de réentraînement.\n\n - Systèmes à grande échelle : Expérience dans le déploiement de systèmes prédictifs, de plateformes de détection d'anomalies ou d'infrastructures de décision automatisée.\n\n - Compétences techniques : Maîtrise de SQL et des ensembles de données transactionnelles massifs.\n\n - Expertise métier : Expérience avec les systèmes de tarification ou les plateformes de rapports financiers.\n\n - Communication : Capacité exceptionnelle à vulgariser des concepts complexes entre les parties prenantes techniques  et commerciales.\n\nAtouts (Bonus) :\n\n - Expérience préalable en science des données, en ingénierie ou dans un rôle hautement technique.\n\nExpérience dans le commerce du voyage, la fintech, la publicité ou d'autres environnements de place de marché à haut volume de transactions.\n\n\n\nCe poste requiert une maîtrise du français et de l’anglais. You will partner deeply with Data Science and Engineering to productionize predictive models, define evaluation frameworks, manage model lifecycles, and ensure intelligence systems are measurable, adaptive, and trusted.\n\nThe work you do will directly shape partner economics, supplier transparency, and HTS’s global commerce platform.\n\nWhat would your day-to-day look like:\n\n - Own the end-to-end strategy and roadmap for pricing intelligence, supplier performance intelligence, and financial reconciliation across all travel verticals.\n   Architect and evolve reference pricing systems leveraging predictive modeling, elasticity signals, competitive benchmarking, and real-time anomaly detection.\n\n - Build the supplier intelligence layer, transforming transactional data into automated performance signals, demand insights, and pricing diagnostics.\n\n - Establish and govern the canonical source of truth for revenue, margin, take rate, transactions, and cancellations across systems and partners.\n   Design model evaluation, monitoring, and feedback frameworks, including drift detection and continuous improvement mechanisms.\n\n - Implement automated reconciliation and anomaly detection systems to proactively surface financial inconsistencies at scale.\n\n - Drive cross-functional execution across Engineering, Data Science, Finance, Commercial, and Supply to deliver production-grade, model-integrated infrastructure.\n   \n\nAn ideal candidate has:\n\n - 5+ years of Product Management experience, including ownership of AI-native products and model-driven systems in production. You have built and scaled systems where AI is foundational to product behavior — not an additive feature.\n\n - Hands-on experience writing prompts, designing evaluation harnesses, or prototyping with LLMs/foundation models as part of their PM workflow (not just overseeing others doing it)\n\n - Demonstrated experience operating as an AI-native PM, with hands-on ownership of model lifecycle management including problem framing, signal design, evaluation metrics (e.g., precision/recall tradeoffs, forecasting accuracy), monitoring frameworks, drift detection, and retraining strategies.\n\n - Experience shipping predictive systems, anomaly detection platforms, automated decisioning infrastructure, or model-driven pricing systems at scale.\n\n - Strong fluency with SQL and large-scale transactional datasets.\n\n - Experience owning pricing systems, financial reporting platforms, marketplace intelligence tools, or reconciliation frameworks.\n\n - Deep understanding of marketplace economics, revenue mechanics, and pricing strategy.\n\n - Track record of delivering complex, cross-functional systems with measurable business impact.\n\n - Exceptional communicator able to operate effectively across technical, financial, and commercial stakeholders.\n\nBonus:\n\n - Prior experience in Data Science, Engineering, or a highly technical role.\n\n - Background in travel commerce, fintech, ads, or other transaction-heavy marketplace environments.\n   \n   \n\nThis position requires proficiency in both French and English. You will be the person who defines what it is: how capabilities are packaged and priced, how partners discover and integrate them, and how the marketplace evolves as a platform business. The underlying technical capabilities — connectivity orchestration, pricing and sort, content mapping, the extranet — are owned by dedicated capability teams. Your job is to work closely with those PMs to understand, package, and commercially expose those capabilities as coherent, enterprise-grade API products.</p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">We expect this PM to move fast and build scrappily. You should be comfortable using AI tools and vibe coding to prototype workflows, mock APIs, and test partner experiences before handing off to engineering. The best candidate will reach for a prototype before a PRD.</p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">You will partner with Engineering, Data Science, Commercial, Finance, and Supply — and coordinate tightly with other PMs across the organization — to bring the marketplace from concept to a revenue-generating platform.</p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"></p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">This is a fully remote role.</p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"></p><h2><strong>What would your day-to-day look like:</strong></h2><ul style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><strong>Define what the HTS API Marketplace is:</strong> how capabilities are structured, packaged, and priced across a portfolio spanning HTS Connect, Search Polygons, Autocomplete, Ranking, Content &amp; Property Mapping, Room Mapping, Deduplication/Auction, Pricing, Extranet, Taxes, and Custom Deals Engine.</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><strong>Coordinate with capability PMs</strong> — who own the underlying technical systems — to understand each capability's roadmap, constraints, and customization surface, and translate that into externally-consumable API products.</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><strong>Own the commercial model for the marketplace:</strong> platform vs. variable fee decisions, take rate structure per capability, enterprise packaging, and the custom deals framework for large partners with differentiated customer segments.</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><strong>Build the developer and partner experience from scratch:</strong> API specifications, partner onboarding flows, documentation standards, sandbox environments, and integration tooling that minimizes time-to-first-value.</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><strong>Use AI tools and rapid prototyping to test ideas quickly </strong>— mock API responses, prototype partner portals, simulate pricing and ranking configurations — before committing engineering resources.</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><strong>Establish the go-to-market motion</strong> for the marketplace: work with Commercial to identify the right partners for each capability, sequence launches, and define what a successful commercial rollout looks like.</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><strong>Own the marketplace revenue P&amp;L</strong>: model and track GBV, take rate, and per-capability unit economics in partnership with Finance.<br /></p></li></ul><h2><strong>An ideal candidate has:</strong></h2><ul By leveraging massive amounts of data and advanced machine learning algorithms, Hopper combines its world-class travel agency offering with proprietary fintech products to bring transparency, flexibility and savings to travelers globally. We have developed several unique fintech solutions that address everything from pricing volatility to trip disruptions, helping people travel better and save more on their trips.\n\nThe Hopper platform serves hundreds of millions of travelers globally and continues to capture market share around the world. The Hopper app has been downloaded over 120 million times and has become largely popular among younger travelers, with 70% of its users being Gen Z and millennials.\n\nWhile many know us as the Gen Z and Millennial travel app, Hopper has evolved to become much more than that. Today, our partners include leading travel brands like Capital One, Nubank, Air Canada, and many more.\n\nHere are just a few stats that demonstrate the company's recent growth: billions of dollars worth of travel and travel fintech are sold through Hopper and HTS's channels every year. Our fintech products, including Cancel for Any Reason and Flight Disruption Assistance, have exceptionally strong CSAT because the terms are always clear and customers receive instant, no-questions-asked resolutions. Almost 30% of our app customers purchase at least one fintech product when making a booking, and consumers are 1.6x more likely to repurchase if they add fintech to their booking versus booking travel alone.\n\nGiven the success of its fintech products, Hopper launched a B2B initiative, HTS (Hopper Technology Solutions), which represents more than 75% of the business. Through HTS, any travel provider, including airlines, hotels, banks, and travel agencies, can integrate and seamlessly distribute Hopper's fintech or travel inventory on their direct channels. As its first HTS partnership, the company partnered with Capital One to co-develop Capital One Travel, a travel portal designed specifically for cardholders. they beat a written spec, to test conversation flows and interface ideas</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Define and defend quality bars with the evaluation team, covering resolution rate, containment, escalation correctness, and conversation quality</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Specify agent behavior in detail, including resolution, tone, escalation policy, guardrails, and edge cases, and iterate from production conversation data</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Stay close to GTM, Partner Solutions, and Success teams, feeding what the field learns back into the style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Design fluency, comfortable manipulating design files and producing flows and basic mocks solo in Figma, having operated as a de facto design lead on a lean team</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">The ability to write enough code to get a prototype working without waiting on an engineer, treating AI tools as a normal part of how they build</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Hands-on front-end experience, having built or shipped web front ends and able to engage engineers credibly</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Deep partner-facing experience with enterprise clients, ideally in regulated industries, shaping requirements and launch decisions at the product level</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">A data-driven approach grounded in customer service and automation metrics, including resolution, containment, CSAT, and escalation quality</p></li><li><p HTS (Hopper Technology Solutions). By leveraging massive amounts of data and advanced machine learning algorithms, Hopper combines its world-class travel agency offering with proprietary fintech products to bring transparency, flexibility and savings to travelers globally. We have developed several unique fintech solutions that address everything from pricing volatility to trip disruptions, helping people travel better and save more on their trips.</p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">The Hopper platform serves hundreds of millions of travelers globally and continues to capture market share around the world. The Hopper app has been downloaded over 120 million times and has become largely popular among younger travelers, with 70% of its users being Gen Z and millennials.</p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">While many know us as the Gen Z and Millennial travel app, Hopper has evolved to become much more than that. In recent years, we've grown into a travel fintech provider, commerce platform, and global travel agency that powers some of the world's largest brands.</p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Through HTS, our B2B division, the company supercharges its partners' direct channels by integrating our fintech products on their sites or powering end-to-end travel portals. Today, our partners include leading travel brands like Capital One, Nubank, Air Canada, and many more.</p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Here are just a few stats that demonstrate the company's recent growth: billions of dollars worth of travel and travel fintech are sold through Hopper and HTS's channels every year. Our fintech products, including Cancel for Any Reason and Flight Disruption Assistance, have exceptionally strong CSAT because the terms are always clear and customers receive instant, no-questions-asked resolutions. Almost 30% of our app customers purchase at least one fintech product when making a booking, and consumers are 1.6x more likely to repurchase if they add fintech to their booking versus booking travel alone.</p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Given the success of its fintech products, Hopper launched a B2B initiative, HTS (Hopper Technology Solutions), which represents more than 75% of the business. Through HTS, any travel provider, including airlines, hotels, banks, and travel agencies, can integrate and seamlessly distribute Hopper's fintech or travel inventory on their direct channels. As its first HTS partnership, the company partnered with Capital One to co-develop Capital One Travel, a travel portal designed specifically for cardholders. Other HTS partners include Air Canada, Uber, CommBank, Nubank, Flair Airlines and many more.</p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Hopper has been named the #1 most innovative company in travel by Fast Company. Hopper has been downloaded over 120 million times and continues to see millions of new installs each month. Hopper is now the #3 largest online travel agency in North America, and 70% of our app customers are Gen Z and millennial travelers.</p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Hopper has raised over $750 million USD of private capital and is backed by some of the largest institutional investors and banks in the world. HTS is primed to continue its growth as the leading travel ecommerce provider in a $1 trillion online shopping category. As Principal Product Manager, you will own the customer-facing agent end to end: the conversations, the interface, and the experience our partners put in front of millions of travelers. This is a deliberately design-leaning role, and you will be the day-to-day design decision-maker, shaping flows and interfaces directly in close partnership with partner design teams and our in-house designer.\n\n\nWhat would your day-to-day look like\n\n - Build working prototypes using AI coding tools where they beat a written spec, to test conversation flows and interface ideas\n\n - Define and defend quality bars with the evaluation team, covering resolution rate, containment, escalation correctness, and conversation quality\n\n - Specify agent behavior in detail, including resolution, tone, escalation policy, guardrails, and edge cases, and iterate from production conversation data\n\n - Stay close to GTM, Partner Solutions, and Success teams, feeding what the field learns back into the roadmap\n   \n\nAn ideal candidate has\n\n - Design fluency, comfortable manipulating design files and producing flows and basic mocks solo in Figma, having operated as a de facto design lead on a lean team\n\n - The ability to write enough code to get a prototype working without waiting on an engineer, treating AI tools as a normal part of how they build\n\n - Hands-on front-end experience, having built or shipped web front ends and able to engage engineers credibly\n\n - Deep partner-facing experience with enterprise clients, ideally in regulated industries, shaping requirements and launch decisions at the product level\n\n - A data-driven approach grounded in customer service and automation metrics, including resolution, containment, CSAT, and escalation quality\n\n - Working familiarity with LLM-based products, including prompt and behavior design, AI quality practices, and their failure modes\n   \n\nPerks and benefits of working with us\n\n - We have developed several unique fintech solutions that address everything from pricing volatility to trip disruptions, helping people travel better and save more on their trips.\n\nThe Hopper platform serves hundreds of millions of travelers globally and continues to capture market share around the world. The Hopper app has been downloaded over 120 million times and has become largely popular among younger travelers, with 70% of its users being Gen Z and millennials.\n\nWhile many know us as the Gen Z and Millennial travel app, Hopper has evolved to become much more than that. In recent years, we've grown into a travel fintech provider, commerce platform, and global travel agency that powers some of the world's largest brands.\n\nThrough HTS, our B2B division, the company supercharges its partners' direct channels by integrating our fintech products on their sites or powering end-to-end travel portals. Our fintech products, including Cancel for Any Reason and Flight Disruption Assistance, have exceptionally strong CSAT because the terms are always clear and customers receive instant, no-questions-asked resolutions. Almost 30% of our app customers purchase at least one fintech product when making a booking, and consumers are 1.6x more likely to repurchase if they add fintech to their booking versus booking travel alone.\n\nGiven the success of its fintech products, Hopper launched a B2B initiative, HTS (Hopper Technology Solutions), which represents more than 75% of the business. Through HTS, any travel provider, including airlines, hotels, banks, and travel agencies, can integrate and seamlessly distribute Hopper's fintech or travel inventory on their direct channels. As its first HTS partnership, the company partnered with Capital One to co-develop Capital One Travel, a travel portal designed specifically for cardholders. As Principal Product Manager, you will own the customer-facing agent end to end: the conversations, the interface, and the experience our partners put in front of millions of travelers. This is a deliberately design-leaning role, and you will be the day-to-day design decision-maker, shaping flows and interfaces directly in close partnership with partner design teams and our in-house designer.\n\n\nWhat would your day-to-day look like\n\n - Own the roadmap for the customer-facing conversational agent across chat and voice, from intent coverage and conversation design to the interfaces partners embed in their apps and websites\n\n - Engage enterprise partners through discovery, requirement shaping, and launch decisions, translating partner asks into product choices that keep one product serving many partners\n\n - Partner with Partner Solutions on implementation and onboarding\n\n - Drive design daily, working hands-on in Figma to produce flows and wireframes, and partner with design on high-fidelity and production assets\n\n - Build working prototypes using AI coding tools where they beat a written spec, to test conversation flows and interface ideas\n\n - Define and defend quality bars with the evaluation team, covering resolution rate, containment, escalation correctness, and conversation quality\n\n - Specify agent behavior in detail, including resolution, tone, escalation policy, guardrails, and edge cases, and iterate from production conversation data\n\n - Stay close to GTM, Partner Solutions, and Success teams, feeding what the field learns back into the roadmap\n   \n\nAn ideal candidate has\n\n - 8+ years of product management experience, including principal or lead-level ownership of a customer-facing product, with conversational AI, customer experience automation, or an adjacent space strongly preferred\n\n - Design fluency, comfortable manipulating design files and producing flows and basic mocks solo in Figma, having operated as a de facto design lead on a lean team\n\n - The ability to write enough code to get a prototype working without waiting on an engineer, treating AI tools as a normal part of how they build\n\n - Hands-on front-end experience, having built or shipped web front ends and able to engage engineers credibly\n\n - Deep partner-facing experience with enterprise clients, ideally in regulated industries, shaping requirements and launch decisions at the product level\n\n - A data-driven approach grounded in customer service and automation metrics, including resolution, containment, CSAT, and escalation quality\n\n - Working familiarity with LLM-based products, including prompt and behavior design, AI quality practices, and their failure modes\n   \n\nPerks and benefits of working with us\n\n -
